messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Art. 46(1)

Article 46 Formal non-compliance. 1. Without prejudice to Article 43, where a Member State makes one of the following findings with regard to machinery or a related product, it shall require the relevant economic operator to put an end to the non-compliance concerned: (a) the CE marking has been affixed in violation of Article 30 of Regulation (EC) No 765/2008 or of Article 24 of this Regulation; (b) the CE marking has not been affixed; (c) the identification number of the notified body involved in the production control phase has been affixed in violation of Article 24(3) or has not been affixed; (d) the EU declaration of conformity has not been drawn up or has not been drawn up correctly; (e) the technical documentation is either not available or not complete; (f) the information referred to in Article 10(6) or Article 13(3) is absent, false or incomplete; (g) any other administrative requirement provided for in Article 10 or Article 13 is not fulfilled.

CE marking | isNotAffixed | non-compliance with Article 46(1)(b) | Member State has made this finding | "the CE marking has not been affixed"
notified body identification number | affixedInViolationOf | Article 24(3) or not affixed | Member State has made this finding | "the identification number of the notified body involved in the production control phase has been affixed in violation of Article 24(3) or has not been affixed"
EU declaration of conformity | isNotDrawnUpOrNotDrawnUpCorrectly | non-compliance with Article 46(1)(d) | Member State has made this finding | "the EU declaration of conformity has not been drawn up or has not been drawn up correctly"
technical documentation | isNotAvailableOrNotComplete | non-compliance with Article 46(1)(e) | Member State has made this finding | "the technical documentation is either not available or not complete"
information referred to in Article 10(6) or Article 13(3) | isAbsentFalseOrIncomplete | non-compliance with Article 46(1)(f) | Member State has made this finding | "the information referred to in Article 10(6) or Article 13(3) is absent, false or incomplete"
other administrative requirement under Article 10 or Article 13 | isNotFulfilled | non-compliance with Article 46(1)(g) | Member State has made this finding | "any other administrative requirement provided for in Article 10 or Article 13 is not fulfilled"
